name: Terp SVG
svg_template:
<svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  
  <defs>
    <filter id="neonglow" x="-90%" y="-90%" width="280%" height="280%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="2.0" flood-color="${glow-color}" flood-opacity="0.96"/>
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="4.6" flood-color="${glow-color}" flood-opacity="0.68"/>
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="9.2" flood-color="${glow-color}" flood-opacity="0.36"/>
    </filter>

    <style>
      
        @keyframes neonBreath {
          0%, 100% { r: 7.4; }
          50%      { r: 12.8; }
        }

        @keyframes strobeFlicker {
          0%, 18%, 22%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
          4%  { opacity: 0.42; }
          9%  { opacity: 0.95; }
          13% { opacity: 0.51; }
          17% { opacity: 0.87; }
        }

        .orb {
          animation:
            neonBreath    var(--pulse-dur)   var(--pulse-delay)   infinite ease-in-out,
            strobeFlicker var(--flicker-dur) var(--flicker-delay) infinite linear;
        }
      
    </style>
  </defs>

  <rect width="200" height="200" fill="black" fill-opacity="0.23"/>

  <g filter="url(#neonglow)">

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="100" cy="100" r="8.7" fill="${color-a}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-a}s;--pulse-delay:-0.11s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-a}s;--flicker-delay:0s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="52" cy="100" r="8.7" fill="${color-b}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-b}s;--pulse-delay:-1.23s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-b}s;--flicker-delay:-0.07s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="148" cy="100" r="8.7" fill="${color-c}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-c}s;--pulse-delay:-0.62s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-c}s;--flicker-delay:0.21s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="100" cy="52" r="8.7" fill="${color-d}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-d}s;--pulse-delay:-1.97s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-d}s;--flicker-delay:-0.29s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="100" cy="148" r="8.7" fill="${color-e}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-e}s;--pulse-delay:-0.38s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-e}s;--flicker-delay:-0.14s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="75" cy="100" r="8.7" fill="${color-f}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-f}s;--pulse-delay:-1.48s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-f}s;--flicker-delay:0.09s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="125" cy="100" r="8.7" fill="${color-g}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-g}s;--pulse-delay:-0.81s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-g}s;--flicker-delay:-0.22s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="100" cy="75" r="8.7" fill="${color-h}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-h}s;--pulse-delay:-1.82s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-h}s;--flicker-delay:0.04s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="100" cy="125" r="8.7" fill="${color-i}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-i}s;--pulse-delay:-0.19s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-i}s;--flicker-delay:-0.39s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="75" cy="75" r="8.7" fill="${color-j}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-j}s;--pulse-delay:-1.09s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-j}s;--flicker-delay:0.14s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="75" cy="125" r="8.7" fill="${color-k}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-k}s;--pulse-delay:-2.31s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-k}s;--flicker-delay:-0.11s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="125" cy="75" r="8.7" fill="${color-l}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-l}s;--pulse-delay:-0.74s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-l}s;--flicker-delay:-0.26s;"/>

    
    <circle class="orb" cx="125" cy="125" r="8.7" fill="${color-m}"
            style="--pulse-dur:${pulse-m}s;--pulse-delay:-1.36s;--flicker-dur:${flicker-m}s;--flicker-delay:0.07s;"/>

  </g>
</svg>
